historical_baseline.description: Frozen after a7af743 mixer match, before bf82458 LegacyVGE match. Its 167 exact routines are the baseline for these controls, not a statement of current repository coverage.

method: Fresh complete original-order native C++ translation-unit builds, VC7 /O2 /Ob1 /MT. Compare all 180 functions after independently identified symbolic relocations are materialized at original addresses for analysis; verify all 25 typed data objects and 11 overlapping fields. No output binary is patched.

control_descriptions.conditional-expression: Compute left +/- right +/- 1 in the true arm of the carry conditional and left +/- right in the false arm.
control_descriptions.conditional-adjust: Compute left +/- right, then conditionally increment or decrement the result.
control_descriptions.lane-only: Repeat the lane-mask lookup instead of caching only the lane local; offset stays cached.
control_descriptions.offset-only: Repeat the offset-mask expression instead of caching only the offset local; lane stays cached.
control_descriptions.unsigned-test: Change only the carry mask from 1 << i to 1U << i, leaving signed flag-clear masks unchanged.
control_descriptions.unsigned-masks: Unsigned carry mask plus unsigned flag-clear mask constants.
control_descriptions.unsigned-flags: Cast the flag operand to CpuU32 before AND while retaining signed 1 << i.
control_descriptions.unsigned-test-not-equal: Unsigned carry mask with unsigned counter and i != 8 loop termination.
control_descriptions.unsigned-test-signed-loop: Unsigned carry mask with CpuS32 counter and i < 8.

instruction_evidence.causal_result: Unsigned carry-mask formation moves the initial carry evaluation ahead of selector address formation in all five arithmetic loops. Widening only the flag operand leaves all 180 bodies identical to baseline. Making the clear masks unsigned too restores selector-first scheduling. The distinction is therefore mask-expression type, not simply the final AND type.
instruction_evidence.remaining_mismatch: The unsigned carry-only forms retain different registers and loop control: for example original VADDExec uses a 12-byte local frame and a spilled two-count decrement loop, while the unsigned-mask candidate uses an 8-byte frame and index/comparison loop. This is not a complete match or a justified source promotion.
